class_distribution.finding: Strong label shift: Шешім grows from 36.5% of train to 64.0% of test while Қаулы falls from 42.4% to 18.8%, so accuracy is dominated by one class and macro-F1 is the right headline metric. For `area`, 'Қаржы' rises from 26.4% (train) to 44.0% (test).

acts_per_year_by_form.finding: Volume peaks in 2023 (15,092 acts); the share of Шешім (local council decisions) rises from 30% in 2010 to 62% in 2023, which explains the form label shift of the temporal split. 9,455 acts predate 2000.

title_length.finding: Median title length is 158 chars / 19 words (p95 337 chars, max 4,071); Заң titles are the shortest (median 142 chars) and Шешім the longest (163); only 47 titles exceed 1000 chars, so truncating long titles loses little.

missingness.finding: Model inputs are complete (title, date_adopted: 0 missing; act_form 0.03%), but placeholders hide a lot of missingness: 'regulatory_body' looks 99.99% filled yet 93,272 rows are placeholders; a naive isna() would miss them.

duplicates.finding: 76,460 rows share their exact title with another row (22,544 distinct titles) while law_id is unique; after removing 6,846 eval rows with a train title, 17.87% of test titles still have a train near-duplicate (cos ≥ 0.9), hence the test_strict subset.

top_bodies.finding: The national Government is the largest single issuer (37,807 acts, 29% repealed), yet the top-15 bodies together adopt only 30.7% of all 215,889 acts: most acts come from the long tail of ~4.2k local bodies (maslikhats, akimats).

area_form_heatmap.finding: The two targets are correlated but not redundant: 7 of 33 areas have one form covering ≥70% of their acts (most concentrated: 'Қаржы', 79.6% Шешім), while the most mixed area 'Қоршаған ортаны қорғау' has at most 36.1% in any single form, so knowing the form does not determine the area.
